Scoring Volume

Longevity & Consistency

A durable career matters. This section explores how many years top international scorers remained active at the highest level.

::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](analysis_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-3-1.png){width=672} ::: :::

Scoring Style

Open-play goals are a key indicator of a striker’s attacking versatility. This measure separates penalty-heavy totals from broader offensive impact.
